title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered
description: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered modernizes Geralt’s acclaimed open-world RPG with upgraded visuals and performance, enhanced combat, improved traversal and movement, new Witcher Sign effects, revamped mount handling, enhanced monster behaviors, a redesigned skill tree, transmogrification, expanded photo mode, new finishers, and more. CD PROJEKT RED has confirmed a native Nintendo Switch 2 version launching September 29, 2026.

CD PROJEKT RED has confirmed a native Nintendo Switch 2 version launching September 29, 2026.

gameplayPillars.title: Upgraded visuals and performance
gameplayPillars.description: CD PROJEKT RED describes broad visual and performance improvements across the Remastered release.

gameplayPillars.title: Enhanced combat
gameplayPillars.description: Combat systems are being revised with improved feel, new finishers, and broader gameplay changes.

gameplayPillars.title: Improved traversal and movement
gameplayPillars.description: Movement and world navigation receive modernization alongside revamped mount handling.

gameplayPillars.title: Reworked progression
gameplayPillars.description: The skill tree is being revamped, with transmogrification and other quality-of-life systems added.

gameplayPillars.title: Expanded presentation tools
gameplayPillars.description: New Sign effects and an expanded photo mode are among the confirmed additions.

worldSummary: The Remastered release revisits the same Northern Kingdoms, Skellige, and expansion regions but with a modernization pass intended to make the decade-old RPG feel more current on newer hardware.

storyChapters.title: Search for Ciri
storyChapters.body: The main narrative remains Geralt’s pursuit of Ciri while the Wild Hunt closes in.

storyChapters.title: Navigate the Northern Kingdoms
storyChapters.body: Political conflict, monster contracts, and personal stories remain central to the open-world structure.

storyChapters.title: Face the Wild Hunt
storyChapters.body: The base campaign culminates in choices and battles surrounding Ciri and the supernatural threat.

storyChapters.title: Revisit the classic expansions
storyChapters.body: Hearts of Stone and Blood and Wine remain part of the modernized Witcher 3 ecosystem.

storyChapters.title: Prepare for Songs of the Past
storyChapters.body: A new paid expansion, Songs of the Past, is scheduled for 2027 on Switch 2 and other current platforms.

faq.q: When does the Switch 2 Remastered version release?
faq.a: September 29, 2026, according to CD PROJEKT RED’s official announcement.
No. CD PROJEKT RED explicitly announced a native Nintendo Switch 2 version of Remastered.

faq.q: Are exact resolution and FPS values confirmed?
faq.a: Not yet. They are intentionally marked Not Announced in this file rather than estimated.

faq.q: Does it include the classic expansions?
faq.a: CD PROJEKT RED’s Remastered ecosystem modernizes the base game and its first two expansions, and existing owners were granted access to Hearts of Stone and Blood and Wine.

faq.q: What is Songs of the Past?
faq.a: It is a newly announced paid expansion planned for 2027, featuring the new region of Letten.
